apariciones.subtitulo: If I save, I'll be able to…

mision.consigna: Write about something you want to buy this year and how you will save for it.
requisitos: five first conditionals
one with *unless*
one with *as soon as*
use *a budget*, *to save up for something* and *to afford*

microtareas.texto: Write five sentences: *If I save … every month, I'll…*
Write three sentences with *unless* about *spending money on* things.
Record 60 seconds: what will you do if you're *short of money* this month?

apariciones.subtitulo: If we had recycled…

mision.consigna: Describe a time when too much waste was produced — at home, at work or at an event — and what would have been different.
requisitos: three third conditionals
one with *If I had known…*
use *waste*, *to recycle* and *single-use plastic*

microtareas.texto: Write three sentences: *If we had…, we wouldn't have…*
Write two sentences about *saving energy*: what could you have done?
Record 60 seconds: a party where there was a lot of *waste*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Advice before buying

mision.consigna: A friend wants to buy a new phone. Give them advice.
requisitos: three pieces of advice with different forms
one *If I were you, I'd…*
use *to compare prices*, *a guarantee* and *a special offer*

microtareas.texto: Write three pieces of advice with *You should…*
Rewrite one with *Why don't you…?*
Record 60 seconds of advice for someone who can't *make up their mind*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Asking to repeat on a trip

use *to be delayed*, *to miss a connection* and *accommodation*

microtareas.texto: Write three questions to ask when you don't understand an announcement.
Write a short dialogue with *Sorry to interrupt, but…*

apariciones.subtitulo: Have to, can, don't have to at work

apariciones.subtitulo: A story about cooking

mision.consigna: Tell the story of a meal you cooked for other people.

use *a meal*, *to follow a recipe* and *home-made*

microtareas.texto: Write the story in five bullet points.

apariciones.subtitulo: Prepositions that belong to the verb
